title: VIDA Host Tool Bridge Adapter Command
description: Configures the optional host bridge command recipe. The project may override values declared by the master template, but may not add undeclared fields or bypass the request placeholder contract.

executable.description: Executable token; it must be non-empty and single-line and must not contain a request placeholder.

subcommands.description: Optional command/subcommand tokens; each token is non-empty, single-line, and placeholder-free.

args.description: Argument tokens with exactly one non-empty {{...}} request placeholder occurrence across the sequence.
